Statuses are a game mechanic in Last Epoch.

## Overview[]

A Status is an influence that can be inflicted upon a target, granting them new properties or modifying them. Positive statuses are called buffs, while negative statuses are known as ailments. Sometimes buffs themselves carry ailments that both affect the target, as a trade-off to limit one particular effect. Some statuses can be applied multiple times in quick succession to stack up, multiplying their effects.

Buffs usually enhances the target's offensive and defensive capabilities, such as enhancing their Skill Speed, granting them resistance, and many more. These can currently be applied mostly to the inflictor and their allies.

On the other hand, ailments hinder the target through decreased damage, defenses. Many ailments deal damage to the target over a set period of time, offering an alternative to dealing damage directly. Ailment damage can be countered with resistances and defensive layers.

Although rare, statuses can be cleansed through specific methods. Target death also cleanses all statuses.
